title: b12126: qwen2 : add nvfp4 scales to build_ffn (#31657)
description: This commit adds nvfp4 scales to qwen2's build_ffn call which are currently passed as NULL. The motivation for this is that a model converted to NVFP4 will currently crash because the scales are loaded but never applied in the FFN: llama-completion: llama.cpp/src/llama-sampler.cpp:1218: void llama_sampler_dist_apply(llama_sampler*, llama_token_data_array*): Assertion `found' failed. The attention already applies its scales but ffn is missing them.

title: b12121
description: llama : fix on-device state copy sizes for quantized KV caches ( #30541 ) llama : fix on-device state copy sizes for quantized KV caches The on-device sequence state copies (LLAMA_STATE_SEQ_FLAGS_ON_DEVICE) computed their element count as size / ggml_element_size(). For a quantized type such as q8_0 or q4_0 that is the number of blocks, not elements, so only part of each range was copied: the restored state was wrong, or the copy crashed. Compute the count as size / ggml_type_size() * ggml_blck_
